literal: lineage - those born - in - will be visible - fault - sky's - moon - in - spot - like - being elevated.
translation: The faults of those born in a noble lineage will be glaringly visible, standing out like the dark spots on the moon high in the sky.
modern: உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களிடம் உள்ள குற்றமானது, வானத்தில் உயர்ந்து விளங்கும் நிலவில் உள்ள களங்கம் போல உலகத்தாருக்குத் தெளிவாகத் தெரியும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that people from noble or respected backgrounds are held to a higher standard. Just as a dark spot is highly visible on the bright moon high in the sky, even a small fault in a person of high standing becomes glaringly obvious to everyone. The word 'உயர்ந்து' (being elevated) connects both the high position of the moon and the high social standing of the noble family, showing how prominence magnifies flaws.
